jsonld.description: Nestled in the heart of Columbus, with easy access to Ohio State University and nearby attractions, experience a boutique style hotel without sacrificing the traditional amenities at the Residence Inn by Marriott Columbus OSU. Unwind with the chic, modern atmosphere of MODA, our onsite restaurant, as you savor locally inspired dishes and craft cocktails. Retreat to a spacious suite in Columbus with fully equipped kitchen and complimentary Wi-Fi or let us bring dinner to you from our in-room a la carte menu. Wake up with our complimentary breakfast buffet or enjoy your morning coffee in our courtyard. Don’t miss a workout and take advantage of our modernly appointed fitness center, swim laps in our saltwater pool, or shoot some hoops on our outdoor sport court. Our upscale, all-suite hotel puts you close to top attractions like Schottenstein Center, Ohio Stadium, Wexner Medical Center and OSU campus. Immerse yourself in a perfect blend of modern comfort and conveniences at the Residence Inn Columbus OSU hotel.
